attention.title: The Prospector runner has been offline for 19 days
attention.why: connor-windows-runner-01 last heartbeat 2026-10-03 10:25 UTC. The cron created 20 campaigns (Murfreesboro and Smyrna, 10 trades) on Oct 13 and nothing has claimed them. The orchestrator now reports BACKLOG_FULL, so no new campaigns get created either. This is the mechanical reason prospecting stops.
attention.action: Start runner.py on the office PC today (python runner.py in C:\dev\trenches-hq\apps\trenches-os\runner with the .env), or say yes to the GitHub Actions runner patch in Trenches-Group/patches/trenches-hq so it never depends on the PC again.

attention.title: Outreach is switched off and pointed at a dead provider
attention.why: OUTREACH_AUTONOMOUS_ORCHESTRATOR_ENABLED has been false since 2026-09-13 (CLAUDE_SAFETY_PAUSE). 90 emails went out Aug 31 to Sep 11, zero since. The Smartlead sender connor.trenches@discovertrenchesgroup.com is warmed at 50/day and has never been used for a campaign.
attention.action: Reply with one sentence: 'Use Smartlead for Trenches outreach' or 'Use Gmail for Trenches outreach'. The partner will prepare the first campaign the same day. Sends still wait for your click.

attention.title: Three quotes sent 9 days ago, zero views
attention.why: Q-1004 Get Lit ($1,499 + $400/mo, sent Oct 12), Q-1005 Benson ($350 + $500/mo, Oct 13) and Q-1006 Benson ($650 + $250/mo, Oct 13). view_count is 0 on all three. Unviewed after a week usually means the email was missed, not declined.
attention.action: Call Patrick Benson and the Get Lit contact today. Tomorrow morning the partner will leave follow-up drafts in your Gmail Drafts in your voice; send the ones you like.

attention.title: Property manager campaign built Oct 13, never launched
attention.why: Recon found 29 verified PM and HOA firms and drafted a 3-email sequence. It is blocked on your mailing address, a subject line, and permission to create the Smartlead draft. Files are in OneDrive Clients/Trenches Group/Outreach/Property Managers Murfreesboro.
attention.action: Send the partner the mailing address line and the subject you want. It will build the Smartlead draft campaign, paused, for your one click.

attention.title: 19 qualified leads have a phone and nobody has called them
attention.why: Plumbers, HVAC, roofers and tree services around Murfreesboro, Smyrna, Columbia and Spring Hill, scored 65 to 80, no website or a broken one. Website-track email outreach requires a verified email, which none of them has, so they sit in QUALIFIED forever.
attention.action: Block 45 minutes and call the top 10. Ask the partner for the call sheet and a 20-second opener; it is in tomorrow's brief.

attention.title: 361 leads stuck in HUMAN_REVIEW because of the scorer bug
attention.why: The digital-gap score only awards points for website_quality, so a lead with no website at all (website_status NONE, quality UNKNOWN) scores 0 of 40 and lands in review. That is the queue you keep clearing by hand. Known since the Oct 1 review, still unfixed in trenches-hq apps/trenches-os/src.
attention.action: Say yes to the scorer fix (website_status NONE, BROKEN, PARKED, SOCIAL_ONLY, PLACEHOLDER earn the gap points) and a requalify run on the 361. Expect 100 to 150 to qualify.

attention.title: Two repos both claim to be the source of truth
attention.why: Trenches-Group (this review's repo) holds the recovered bundle and docs; trenches-hq holds the TypeScript source, agents, skills and client logs, and is what actually deploys. Trenches-Group has not been pushed since Oct 9. Keeping both means every fix has to land twice.
attention.action: Confirm: trenches-hq is the code; Trenches-Group keeps only docs/reviews and the dashboard. The partner will then stop syncing bundles into Trenches-Group.

attention.title: Smartlead API key is sitting in plaintext in a routine prompt
attention.why: The Vivid Outreach Reply Check prompt contains the full api_key. The Smartlead webhook secret is also plaintext in system_flags. House rule 13 says rotate on sight.
attention.action: Rotate the key in Smartlead, add it to the Claude environment as SMARTLEAD_API_KEY, and the partner will update the reply-check routine to read it from the environment.

attention.title: Stripe secret key was invalid on Oct 9; status unknown
attention.why: The _trenches log says prod STRIPE_SECRET_KEY was an mk_ key id, breaking checkout. No later entry says it was rotated.
attention.action: Confirm the rotation happened, then run docs/pricing-gate/smoke-live-stripe.mjs in trenches-hq.

attention.title: Orphaned pipeline state makes every dashboard lie
attention.why: 111 ACTIVE concierge sequences with no reader since Sep 13, 83 QUEUED and 73 FAILED candidates on dead campaigns, 3 FAILED demo jobs, 7 test reply drafts from August.
attention.action: Say 'clean it up' and the partner cancels the sequences with stop_reason ORPHANED_2026-09-13, fails the dead candidates and archives the 258 failed campaigns. Nothing customer-facing changes.

attention.title: Marketplace monitor and books refresh finish in under 30 seconds
attention.why: Both routines report success but ran 23 s and 18 s on Oct 19. The marketplace monitor needs Chrome on your desktop, which a cloud run cannot reach. [Guessing] Both are exiting early on a missing tool and reporting success.
attention.action: Open the Oct 19 run of each in claude.ai/code and read the final message. If they bailed, the partner will rewrite them to fail loudly.

next.title: Get the runner back today.
next.body: Nothing else in the pipeline matters while 20 campaigns sit unclaimed. The PC restart takes two minutes; the GitHub Actions version takes one yes and two secrets and never sleeps.

next.title: Make the Trenches outreach decision in one sentence.
next.body: Smartlead already has a warmed Trenches sender and the Vivid reply watcher proves the API works. Gmail caps you at 10 a day and needs the reply code restored. Pick Smartlead unless you want to stay under the radar at low volume.

next.title: Call the three open quotes before building anything new.
next.body: $2,499 up front and $1,150 a month is on the table from people who already said yes to a conversation. Zero views in nine days is a delivery problem, not a no.

next.title: Approve the scorer fix and the orchestrator guard together.
next.body: One PR in trenches-hq: gap points for no-website leads, no campaign creation while no runner has heartbeated in 15 minutes, stale READY campaigns expire after 7 days. The 361-lead review queue mostly disappears.

next.title: Let the partner clean house.
next.body: Orphaned sequences, dead candidates and failed campaigns make every count on this page and in the Command Center wrong. It is a one-time SQL you approve.

Runner on the office PC permanently, or move it to GitHub Actions (needs RUNNER_API_KEY as a repo secret)?
Is trenches-hq the only code repo from now on, with Trenches-Group kept for docs and this dashboard?
May the partner write to D1 for internal bookkeeping only (flags, events, orphan cleanup), never to leads or customers?
